name: System service mutation guard
summary: Block direct operating-system service lifecycle and configuration mutations.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate that refuses mutating systemd, launchd, SysV, and Windows service-manager operations while permitting status and inspection commands.
risk_reason: This automatic gate blocks direct operating-system service lifecycle and configuration mutations; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not start, stop, enable, disable, or reconfigure services.
It does not infer whether a named service is safe or disposable.
It does not accept prompt text or environment variables as service authority.

entrypoints.purpose: Classify system service manager operations and refuse state mutations.

linkReasons.hook/security/application-security/shell: system-service-mutation-guard cannot see hidden commands (e.g. bash -c "$X"): shell-command-guard stops them.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to block direct operating-system service lifecycle and configuration mutations without deferred work.
